items.corrections: Primary NEJM paper supports functional islet replacement in a small study using immunosuppression; beta-cell regeneration with antigen-specific autoimmune tolerance and lifelong cure remain unsupported.
Opened equivalent review explicitly calls for experiments distinguishing competing body-weight regulation models; no one-time permanent safe set-point lowering therapy is demonstrated.
Opened actual publisher abstract lays out desired ovarian-aging delay strategies; safe follicle regeneration, cyclic restoration, cancer risk and later fertility impacts remain unsupported.
Read Perspective concerns broad immune depletion and remission concepts across selected autoimmune diseases. It does not show endocrine-specific clone removal preserving all immunity.
Mini-review explicitly says puberty triggers are incompletely understood; complete central/peripheral clock plus fully reversible therapy is an unachieved aspiration in this evidence.
Weekly injected replacement GH trial is background to the assigned gene/cell therapy goal; it does not restore endogenous pulsatility once for life.
PCOS review characterizes heterogeneous pathophysiology and diagnostic disputes; it does not identify a single primary driver and permanent safe treatment.
The DiRECT trial demonstrates remission after intensive weight-management intervention, but does not substantiate the proposed weight-independent mechanism.
Read source is a review of thyroid organoid models and experimental transplant reports. No inspected primary study supports a scalable patient-matched lifelong multi-gland platform.

Opened equivalent review supports21OHD management research; full genetic characterization of all CAH and one-time gene editing are not established. Prior halted-trial detail was not independently verified.
